label: PrimeNG
notes: PrimeNG binds values with [(ngModel)]; ngn controls use a signal `value` model — migrate `[(ngModel)]="x"` to `[(value)]="x"` (or reactive forms via ngn-input-field). PrimeNG form controls are usually standalone; ngn form controls are typically wrapped in `ngn-input-field` for label/hint/error chrome. Icons are set via `icon*` inputs (e.g. `iconDropdown`) or projected `ngn-icon`, not template slots. Always verify target inputs with get_control before rewriting.

components.notes: Attribute directive on a native <button>/<a>. Label and icon are projected content, not inputs.

props.notes: Project the label as the button's text content.
Project an ngn-icon element; use kind="icon" for an icon-only button.
Map severity onto kind + color; see the theming kinds-colors guide and get_theme_options.

gaps: ngnButton has no `loading` or `disabled` input — use the native [disabled] attribute and render your own loading state.

components.notes: Options are passed via `options`; item label/value come from the item shape or `templateItem`. Placeholder/label live on the wrapping ngn-input-field.
gaps: No `optionLabel` / `optionValue` / `showClear` inputs — set the item label via `templateItem`, and clearing via ngn-input-field's `showClearButton`.

props.notes: ngn-select uses `checkbox` for multi-select affordance; chip display differs — verify with get_control.

components.notes: Use editable ngn-select (`editable`). Server-side suggestion loading differs — verify capabilities.
gaps: Async suggestion completion works differently; may need custom filtering.
No `minDate`/`maxDate` or `selectionMode` inputs — verify range/min-max support with get_control before relying on it.

components.notes: Group radios with ngn-radio-group; bind [(value)] on the group.

Attribute directive on native <input>/<textarea>; wrap in ngn-input-field for chrome. Move any `id` off the input onto the wrapper: `<ngn-input-field [inputId]="'old-id'">` — the field overwrites an id left on the projected input, breaking external `<label for>` / `aria-describedby` references.

gaps: No dedicated password meter component; use a native password input with ngnInput.
No dual-thumb `range` input; use two sliders or a custom control for ranges.

props.notes: Header/footer are projected/inputs; verify with get_control.

components.notes: Trigger + content projection differs; verify with get_control.

props.notes: The text is the directive value.
Verify menu item shape with get_control.

components.notes: Tab panels are projected; verify structure with get_control.
Column/template model differs substantially. Migrate incrementally and verify with get_control + the table docs.
gaps: Feature parity for advanced datatable features (row grouping, cell editing, virtual scroll) must be verified case by case.

components.notes: ngn also ships ngn-snackbar; pick per UX.
Apply ngnInput to a native <textarea>; wrap in ngn-input-field.
ngn-input-field provides icon slots + clear button; use its iconClearButton/showClearButton rather than a separate icon-field wrapper.
Compose addons as projected content inside ngn-input-field.
ngn ships both ngn-inplace and ngn-edit-inplace; pick per behavior.

gaps: No star-rating control in ngn; build one from icons + a form control, or keep PrimeNG for this.
No color-picker control in ngn; use a native <input type=color> or a third-party picker.
No card/panel container control; compose layout with plain elements + Tailwind and ngn controls for the contents.
No split-button control; compose a button[ngnButton] with an ngn-menu for the dropdown actions.
